message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a tool or data set that can locate a “pet‑friendly” train station. Train stations themselves don’t typically have a pet‑friendly designation—pets are usually allowed on the trains (subject to size and carrier rules) rather than at the station. If you’re looking for a specific station in Miami that accepts pets on the train, you might want to check with the local transit authority (e.g., Tri‑Rail or the Metrorail system) or look at the individual train operator’s pet policy.
